notes.title: Development update on upcoming projects
notes.notes:
Hello everyone!

It's been a while since the last announcement, so here's an update on how things are. In the last announcement, I mentioned that two VN projects were already in the works. Development on both is still ongoing. Below is a bit more information on each one.



Cold Verdict 3



This will be the third and final part in the Cold Verdict series. (PS: The first Cold Verdict is currently on a discount at the time of this update, so might be a good time to get it if you haven't yet)



Cold Verdict 3 will be roughly the same length as the first two instalments and will be priced about the same. All of the story points and questions from the previous two games should be concluded and resolved in this one. At the moment I'm aiming to release it sometime near the end of the year.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45268392/a264ad649174340d1c7f0db783638df2ae6f4391.png"]



Post-apocalyptic sci-fi project that currently still has no definite name



A lot more work has been done on this one over the last few months. As mentioned in the last update, this one will be a bigger game than Cold Verdict 3 and at least as long as Interim Crossroads. This story will involve relationship building, choices with consequences, character stats to keep track of, multiple endings, as well as a choice to play as either a male or a female main character. The choice to play as male or female is not just cosmetic here. The intention is to provide a somewhat different experience, where characters will treat you differently depending on whether you're male or female. This means some dialogues will differ, some scenes, romance options, and even some of the endings. 



There's no definite title for this project yet, but this will come later on in development. The release date for this one will most likely be in early 2026, so it should hopefully not be a long time after Cold Verdict 3 release when this one will also be out. Also keep a look out for more development updates in the coming months.



For now, I hope you enjoy some screenshots below from this project.
